cands.name: Jane Aman
cands.bio: Democrat, 33. Full-time UCF lecturer teaching American literature; previously taught three years at Crooms Academy. Political newcomer; says she decided to run after seeing UCF students struggle financially.
cands.local_ties: Says she has "deep roots in Central Florida"; campaign mailing address in Orlando (campaign site).

record.text: First campaign; no prior office. Opposes Amendment 3 and supports Medicaid expansion and a data-center moratorium.

endorsements.text: Listed on her site: Rep. Maxwell Frost, Sen. Carlos Guillermo Smith, Rep. Anna Eskamani, Ruth's List, Florida AFL-CIO, FEA, SEIU Florida, Equality Florida Action PAC and local officials.

cands.gaps: Donors not found; photo is the portrait graphic from her own site. Owner-source check was limited: the alexjoneslive.com site search was run for this name and returned no results. stewpeters.com, rumble.com and infowars.com searches were blocked (HTTP 403) and the shared web-search quota was exhausted, so those were NOT checked.

cands.name: Robert Prater
cands.bio: Republican. Orange County Public Schools teacher and former Dean of Students (20+ years); carpentry training; father of seven. Switched from HD 43 to HD 37 at the last minute after Rep. Susan Plasencia withdrew.
cands.local_ties: Says he has lived in the Seminole/Orange County area for 38 years (campaign site).

record.text: Lost the 2020 race to Rep. Carlos Guillermo Smith and finished last in the 2018 Orange County School Board chair race.
Previously worked for Rep. Susan Plasencia as an education consultant and helped her brother Rene Plasencia's campaign.

endorsements.text: Central Florida Hotel and Lodging Association PAC.
Listed on his site: Seminole Sheriff Dennis Lemma, BusinessForce, Florida State Fraternal Order of Police, Associated Builders and Contractors Central Florida.

cands.gaps: Age conflicts (37 in the voter guide, 63 in Florida Politics), so none is given. Donors not found.
